items.label: Lifetime gift count
items.description: All gifts recorded for the profile.

items.label: Lifetime giving
items.description: Sum of all recorded gift amounts.

items.label: Giving in the last 12 months
items.description: Sum of gift amounts dated within the last 365 days.

items.label: Gifts in the last 12 months
items.description: Number of gifts dated within the last 365 days.

items.label: First gift date
items.description: Date of the profile's first dated gift.

items.label: Last gift date
items.description: Date of the profile's most recent dated gift.

items.label: Largest gift
items.description: Largest amount among recorded gifts.

items.label: Average gift
items.description: Average amount among recorded gifts.

items.label: Active recurring donor
items.description: True when a recurring gift was made within the last 45 days.

items.label: Days since last gift
items.description: Whole days between the pinned as_of date and last gift date.

items.label: Donor status
items.description: Prospect, new, active, reactivated, lapsing, or lapsed based on gift history.

items.label: RFM recency
items.description: Donor-only recency quintile; 5 is most recent.

items.label: RFM frequency
items.description: Donor-only lifetime gift-count quintile; 5 is highest frequency.

items.label: RFM monetary
items.description: Donor-only lifetime giving quintile; 5 is highest giving.

items.label: RFM score
items.description: Concatenated recency, frequency, and monetary quintile scores.

items.label: Events in the last 30 days
items.description: Count of events recorded during the last 30 days.

items.label: Last event time
items.description: Timestamp of the most recent event.

items.label: Video views in the last 30 days
items.description: Count of events named Video Watched during the last 30 days.

items.label: Last engagement channel
items.description: Source key for the most recent event or gift.

items.label: Source keys
items.description: Sorted unique source keys represented by records, gifts, or events.

items.label: Traits computed at
items.description: Timestamp when this row of computed traits was generated.
